description: Paid routes require a funded Base USDC wallet. Use readfetch-client / @readfetch/client or the MCP signing proxy (@readfetch/mcp-x402-proxy). Direct calls without a signing client will stop at 402. Start a bounded async crawl from one seed URL. Returns job_id, status (queued), pages_quoted, and price_usd — then poll readfetch_crawl_status with that id until status is complete or failed. A complete job includes per-page url and Markdown in the status payload. Cap scope with max_pages (default 20, max 100) and max_depth (default 2, max 3); include/exclude filter paths by prefix (* suffix on include). Prefer readfetch_batch for a fixed URL list; readfetch_map to list URLs without fetching bodies; readfetch_text for a single page.

exclude.description: Path prefixes to skip during the crawl.

include.description: Path prefixes to allow; * suffix wildcard.

max_depth.description: Link depth from the seed URL (default 2).

max_pages.description: Maximum pages to fetch in this job (quoted up front for payment).

url.description: Seed URL; crawl stays on the same registrable domain.

name: readfetch_crawl
